name: browser-use
headline: writing-plans: Project Planning
short_description: The writing-plans skill for Claude Code automates the creation of structured plans for projects, enhancing productivity and organization. It streamlines the planning process, allowing users to focus on execution.
author: obra

sections.overview:
The writing-plans skill for Claude Code is designed to automate the creation of structured project plans, making it an essential tool for developers, product managers, and AI practitioners. By leveraging this skill, users can quickly generate comprehensive plans that outline project goals, timelines, and resource allocations, thus eliminating the need for manual planning. This automation not only saves time but also ensures consistency and clarity in project documentation. One of the key benefits of the writing-plans skill is its ability to streamline workflow automation. By integrating this skill into your project management processes, you can significantly reduce the time spent on planning activities. This allows teams to allocate more time towards execution and innovation, enhancing overall productivity. The skill's intuitive design means that even those with minimal technical expertise can implement it effectively. The writing-plans skill is particularly beneficial for project managers and developers who need to coordinate multiple tasks and stakeholders. For instance, a product manager can use this skill to quickly draft a project plan for a new feature rollout, ensuring all team members are aligned on objectives and deadlines. Similarly, an AI practitioner can utilize it to outline research projects, making it easier to track progress and deliverables. Implementation of the writing-plans skill is straightforward, making it accessible for users at all skill levels. It fits seamlessly into AI-first workflows, enabling teams to harness the power of AI automation in their planning processes. By adopting this skill, organizations can enhance their project management capabilities, leading to more efficient and successful outcomes.
Generate detailed project plans for new software features, ensuring all aspects are covered.
Outline research projects in AI development, helping teams stay organized and focused.
Create structured timelines for product launches, allowing for better scheduling and resource allocation.
Draft collaborative plans for complex tasks, ensuring all team members are on the same page.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/obra/superpowers`
sections.usage:
```
Create a detailed project plan for [PROJECT NAME] with the following objectives: [OBJECTIVES]. Include a timeline with key milestones, resource allocation, and risk management strategies. Format the plan as a structured document with clear sections for each phase of the project.
```
Copy

```
Project Plan for Website Redesign

Objectives:
- Improve user experience
- Increase mobile responsiveness
- Boost conversion rates

Timeline:
- Research & Planning: Weeks 1-2
- Design Phase: Weeks 3-5
- Development Phase: Weeks 6-10
- Testing & QA: Weeks 11-12
- Launch & Monitoring: Week 13

Key Milestones:
- Week 2: Finalize wireframes and design mockups
- Week 5: Approve final design
- Week 10: Complete development of core features
- Week 12: Final testing and bug fixes
- Week 13: Launch the new website

Resource Allocation:
- Project Manager: Full-time
- UX Designer: Full-time
- Frontend Developer: Full-time
- Backend Developer: Part-time
- QA Engineer: Part-time

Risk Management:
- Potential Risks: Delays in design approval, technical issues during development, unexpected bugs
- Mitigation Strategies: Regular check-ins with stakeholders, continuous testing, buffer time in the schedule

Budget: $50,000

Stakeholders:
- Marketing Team
- Sales Team
- IT Department
- Executive Management
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
